title: OEE Calculation Standard
text: Availability equals runtime divided by planned production time. Performance compares actual output with theoretical output. Quality equals good output divided by total output.

title: Quality Hold Procedure
text: A quality hold must be created when defect rate exceeds the control threshold or when inspection fails critical dimensions.

title: Preventive Maintenance Escalation
text: Machines with repeated alarms within seven days require inspection and a maintenance work request.

title: Responsible AI Use in Manufacturing Analytics
text: Model outputs must be explained, monitored for drift, and reviewed by process owners before operational action.

title: Data Quality Control Rules
text: Negative quantities, end times before start times, and out-of-range sensor readings must be flagged before KPI calculation.

title: SCADA Alarm Handling
text: Critical alarms should be acknowledged by the operator and linked to downtime or maintenance evidence when applicable.

title: Late Delivery Root Cause Coding
text: Late deliveries are assigned to production delay, material shortage, quality hold, or logistics delay based on evidence.

title: Edge Device Telemetry Format
text: Each MQTT payload includes machine identifier, temperature, vibration, pressure, current, state, and data quality flag.
